_comment: Shape the scoring agent fills after judging each sampled transcript against scorers/efficiency.md and scorers/code-quality.md. Get a pre-filled skeleton with: python scripts/score_aggregator.py --inventory RUN/inventory.json --emit-template. Labels must come from the rubric tables; score_aggregator.py derives all numbers and rejects anything else.
top_findings: Files were re-read verbatim in 4 of 9 sessions before any edit was attempted
deploy-checklist never fired in 3 sessions whose first user message contained the word 'deploy'
Two sessions repeated a fix-test cycle three times on the same lint failure a pre-commit run would have caught

efficiency.label: mostly_inefficient
efficiency.reason: Three fix-test cycles on the same import error; running the repo's lint target once before the first edit would have caught it.

code_quality.label: block
code_quality.reason: Left a debug print in src/api/client.py and the new retry helper duplicates the backoff logic already in src/util/net.py.

efficiency.label: mostly_efficient
efficiency.reason: One duplicated read of the config file early on; the rest of the run was direct with batched searches.

code_quality.label: insufficient_evidence
code_quality.reason: Research-only session; no diff was produced in the transcript.
